_description: Per-finding allowlist for scripts/audit/odoo_audit.py CRITICAL/HIGH findings. Each entry is a known, human-reviewed false positive or accepted item — NOT a blanket count baseline. Any finding whose fingerprint is not in this list fails the audit-baseline CI job (fix the code, or add a new reviewed entry here).
_how_to_add_entries: python3 scripts/audit/check_baseline.py odoo_audit_report.json ci/baselines/odoo_audit_baseline.json --severities CRITICAL,HIGH --dump-new -- review the output, then merge the printed entries into this file. Never edit scripts/audit/odoo_audit.py to special-case a finding.
_root_cause: The audit scanner attributes view fields only from ir.ui.view arch, switches to the comodel inside relational subviews, and resolves fields added by _inherit (string or list) across the view module's manifest depends closure, plus the verified Odoo 19 mail.thread / mail.activity.mixin fields. That retired the 87 FIELD_NOT_FOUND entries, each traced to a real field definition or to non-view record data. Remaining entries are the current reviewed CRITICAL/HIGH findings and continue to gate any new fingerprint.
